notes.title: Linux and Mac fix incoming
notes.notes:
Hi everybody!

We have heard your complaints about various issues with the MAC and Linux versions of Anna EE and have been working hard to fix them. As we have now migrated to Unity 4.2 it is fairly possible that this fix is going to eradicate most of the issues that you were experiencing. Please download it and give us feedback if the game runs better for you now. Here is a short changelog:

- Unity version upgraded to 4.2: better Linux and MAC stability and better performances
- Localization fix for various sentences
- Numbers in recap screen fixed

Thanks for your support and many greetings,
Chris

notes.title: Screen resolution and blackscreen patch
notes.notes:
Hi everybody!

Over the last few weeks, we have been getting some reports from people that are experiencing problems with different screen resolutions and/or blackscreens on startup on PC and MAC. We have looked into this and found that while we cannot really pinpoint what the problem in each individual case is, we of course want every customer to be able to play the game. So what have we done? With the recent patch (as of today) every PC and MAC customer will get a small resolution menu BEFORE the game even starts (actually it is just the normal Unity selector we re-implemented). This way, you can figure out which resolution works best for you. It would be cool if any of you that had experienced problems before could give us feedback if this helped in any way. Oh in case you are wondering: Unity does not support this startup resolution menu on LINUX as of yet so that is why this is only available on PC and MAC. Once Unity supports it, we will of course patch that for Linux as well. 

Many greetings and have a great weekend!

-Chris

notes.title: Statement about account creation issues
notes.notes:
Hi everybody!

We are getting some reports that some of you do not receive their account verification emails. Sometimes these emails get swept into the spam folder. So please check that folder. But in some cases, some US providers block the account we are sending those emails from. We have contacted those provides several times but they dont seem to react. 

Of course, it may sometimes also be a temporary network problem on our end.

In case you do not get your verification emails for a long time, please contact support@kalypsomedia.com and our support team will unlock your account manually. 

Sorry for the inconvenience!

Many greetings,
Chris

notes.title: Now Available on Mac - Anna, 10% off!
notes.notes:
Anna is Now Available on Mac and is 10% off*!

Anna is a first-person horror adventure that explores the darkest depths of the human psyche. Set in an abandoned sawmill nestled high in the mountains, Anna challenges you to uncover horrific clues and use them to solve puzzles related to your character’s dark past. As you play, Anna will unlock locations and unveil new secrets. The way you play will not only determine the mental health of your main character, but will also lead to one of three possible endings.

*Discount offer ends November 16th at 10AM Pacific time
